---
title: Share a site
description: Give people and groups access, Google Docs style.
sidebar: { order: 3 }
---

New sites are **private**: only the owner can open them.

Click **Share**, then search for a person or an Entra ID group and pick a role:
- **Can view:** open and use the app.
- **Can edit:** change and publish it too.

Group membership is checked live, so someone who leaves a group loses access straight away.

## Org-wide access
Owners can choose **Everyone in your organization can view**. Admins can turn this option off.

## Transfer ownership
**Share → Transfer ownership** hands the site to another person, for example when you change roles. Admins can transfer any site.

## Outside people
Bunker never shares outside your Entra tenant. There are no public links.
